stories.title: Russia's RD-93MS Takes an Unexpected Role in Future Supersonic Aviation
stories.summary: Russia is adapting the RD-93MS engine for the Strizh supersonic civil aircraft demonstrator, taking a fighter-engine design into an entirely new aviation programme. Ground tests have confirmed the required thrust characteristics, while specially developed flat nozzles and noise suppression technology address the challenges of civilian supersonic flight.

stories.title: GXO and Apptronik target deployment of up to 1,000 humanoid robots
stories.summary: GXO Logistics signed a letter of intent with Apptronik to explore a global deployment of up to 1,000 Apollo humanoid robots over the next four years. Operational trials begin in 2027, with a potential first commercial deployment in North America in late 2027, contingent on meeting agreed performance and safety targets.

stories.title: Fire reported at industrial facility in Russia's Tatarstan amid drone attack
stories.summary: A large fire was reported in Nizhnekamsk, Tatarstan, overnight on Nov. 15 amid reports of a drone attack targeting the city's industrial zone, according to local residents and Ukrainian monitoring channels.

stories.title: In the ‘kill zone’, Ukraine bets on flying evacuation drones
stories.summary: Ukrainian manufacturer Skyfall developed the Stargate evacuation drone to rescue wounded soldiers from the front line's "kill zone," where ground drones struggle to operate. The 400kg carbon-fibre craft travels at 105kmh, carries up to 150kg, and costs about US$50,000, with Skyfall aiming to produce a thousand per month by the end of 2026.

stories.title: Not Just Building Ships... HD Hyundai Bets on Unmanned Vessel Design and Technology
stories.summary: HD Hyundai launched the medium-sized unmanned surface vessel Alpha on the 12th, a project completed in seven months with US defense company Anduril Industries. The company plans to export its VAone autonomous-navigation technology and expand its design business to other ship types and overseas shipyards.

also.title: HD Hyundai launches autonomous vessel developed with Anduril
HD Hyundai and Anduril unveil 600-ton autonomous warship to court US Navy

stories.title: Poland wants to obtain Ukrainian drone detection technologies in exchange for MiG-29 fighter jets
stories.summary: Poland is negotiating the transfer of two MiG-29s to Ukraine in exchange for drone detection technologies. Polish Deputy Defense Minister Cezary Tomczyk said the parties are coordinating final details, with Ukrainian acoustic systems already being tested in Poland.

stories.title: Italy has begun installing anti-drone protection on the tanks it transferred to the Armed Forces of Ukraine, following Ukraine’s example — what has changed
stories.summary: The Italian military began installing anti-drone structures on B1 Centauro wheeled tanks, following adaptations made by Ukrainian troops. These metal protective structures, known as “grills,” cover the turret from above and on the sides to defend against drone attacks.

stories.title: Ukraine Says Starshield Restrictions Persist, Hampering Drone Defenses
stories.summary: Ukrainian diplomat Denys Sienik said on November 14 that widespread restrictions on SpaceX’s Starshield satellite communications persist, preventing forces from intercepting Russian jet-powered drones near the front line. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that terminals in temporarily occupied territories faced speed limits of approximately 161 kilometers per hour for five days, while SpaceX told Ukrainian officials it was not imposing any restrictions.

also.title: Starshield restrictions in Ukraine continue – Russian drones have become more difficult to intercept near the front line

stories.title: Standardized Frequency Filter Optimization Reduces Motion Sickness in Autonomous Vehicle Simulations
stories.summary: Researchers Ishu Jaiswal, Somnath Buriuly, and Arpita Sinha demonstrated that embedding standardized frequency-shaping filters into a vehicle’s spatial path planner substantially reduces simulated passenger motion sickness. The study, published in Discover Vehicles, showed that trajectory planners driven by standardized frequency-weighted costs achieve lower motion sickness dose values than raw energy-minimizing formulations.

stories.title: The Vietnamese robotics market is growing rapidly due to the wave of factory relocation from China.
Sheridan Manufacturers Are Adding Robots And Hiring Workers At The Same Time
stories.summary: EMIT Technologies in Sheridan is installing four robotic arms by mid-November to handle repetitive welding, freeing an estimated 22 welders for more complex tasks. CEO Casey Osborn stated the company needs 70 welders but cannot hire them fast enough, so the robots allow the firm to produce more and create demand for additional workers.

stories.title: MetaX and UBTech's robot chip venture Xilect raises 500 million yuan
stories.summary: Xilect, a joint venture between MetaX and UBTech Robotics, completed a 500 million yuan angel round led by GGV Capital and Matrix Partners China to build a domestic computing platform for embodied AI. The company plans to tape out its chip in the second half of 2027 and begin mass production in 2028.

stories.title: Largest Air Force in the World Unveils Force Design 2026, Prioritizes AI, Autonomous Aircraft and Advanced Sensors
stories.summary: The US Air Force introduced Force Design 2026 on November 10, 2026, replacing the 2024 One Force Design framework. The new strategy prioritizes advanced sensors, artificial intelligence, and autonomous systems over individual aircraft, aiming to build an integrated network of military capabilities for contested environments.

stories.title: DJI Air 3S Firmware v01.00.1900 Lands With Six Others and No Details
stories.summary: DJI released firmware v01.00.1900 for the DJI Air 3S on November 13, 2026, alongside updates for six other drones. The release notes state only that the updates fixed known issues, with no specific details provided.

stories.title: In Romanian waters, a drone struck a ship that was heading to Ukraine
stories.summary: A drone struck the Palau-flagged cargo ship Larissa 1 in Romanian territorial waters near Sfântu Gheorghe, damaging only the cargo crane. Romanian Defense Minister Ștefan-Radu Oprea confirmed the incident and stated that the investigation is ongoing.

also.title: Three commercial ships struck by drones near Romania's Black Sea coast over two days

stories.title: Tesla Opens $29,990 Cybercab to Select Private Buyers in Push for Autonomous Vehicle Sales
stories.summary: Tesla announced on Friday that select customers can purchase its two-seat Cybercab for $29,990, with an additional $299 monthly subscription for autonomous driving services. Chief Executive Elon Musk stated the program would eventually be available nationwide, subject to regulatory approval.

also.title: Tesla is inviting some people to buy a Cybercab ‘for personal use’ — but read the fine print

stories.title: Why the U.S. Army backs KHA’s K1000ULE solar endurance drone
Attalon and ACS Pair Valaris Laser With Bullfrog Counter-Drone Station
stories.summary: Attalon and ACS announced a partnership on Nov. 12, 2026, to integrate Attalon’s Valaris high-energy laser subsystems with ACS’s Bullfrog autonomous weapon station. The companies stated the pairing aims to counter low-cost weaponized drones for U.S. and allied governments.

stories.title: Tesla Cybercabs Filmed by the Dozen in Dallas Before Planned Launch
stories.summary: Dozens of Tesla Cybercabs were filmed parked in Dallas on Saturday, more than three weeks after Vice President of AI Software Ashok Elluswamy said the robotaxi would launch in the city in November. The vehicles arrived on trucks, and Tesla has not announced Cybercab rides in Dallas, where its Robotaxi service currently uses Model Ys.

stories.title: Waymo Fails to Recognize Police Car... Controversies Over Repeated Unexpected Responses in San Francisco.. Waymo Robotaxi Hesitates Repeatedly Before Traffic Control
stories.summary: A Waymo robotaxi attempted to pass a California Highway Patrol traffic blockade on northbound I-280 in San Francisco on the 6th. The vehicle also drove in the opposite direction near Raymond James Stadium in Tampa, Florida, last month.

stories.title: eVTOL Aircraft Cost $300,000 to $4 Million; Air Taxi Fares Seen Falling From $3-$8 to $1-$2 Per Mile
stories.summary: eVTOL aircraft purchase prices range from $300,000 to $4 million, with the EHang EH216-S listed at about $410,000. Air taxi fares are expected to start at $3 to $8 per mile in 2026-2027 and fall to $1 to $2 per mile by 2030.

stories.title: Elon Musk Says Cybercab’s $299 Monthly ‘Autonomy Fee’ is Too High
stories.summary: Elon Musk stated that the US$299 monthly autonomy fee for Tesla’s Cybercab is too high and should match the approximately US$115 monthly cost of FSD and connectivity on other models. He also noted that the vehicle will be available nationwide as regulatory approval is received, though he did not announce a price reduction.

also.title: Tesla Opens Cybercab Sales with New $299 Monthly Fee, Musk Says ‘Too High’
Tesla opens $29,990 Cybercab orders, but owners face $299 monthly fee to drive

stories.title: Ukraine’s Naval Drones Are Now Threatening Russian Targets on Land
stories.summary: Ukraine’s Main Intelligence Directorate adapted Magura naval drones to carry aerial drones for land-based strikes, destroying a Russian Pantsir-S1 air-defense system and two S-400 launchers in August. UFORCE founder Oleg Rogynskyy said the company raised $700 million in a Series A funding round, bringing its valuation to $6 billion to support expanded manufacturing.

also.title: Ukraine’s naval drones are no longer targeting only ships

stories.title: US Army Fires 18-Drone Swarm From Container-Launched UGV
stories.summary: The US Army demonstrated an unmanned ground vehicle that launched 18 first-person-view drones from a shipping container at Grafenwoehr Training Area in Bavaria, Germany, on November 12, 2026. The exercise, staged under the Remote Rapid Response Autonomous Contingency Team effort, involved soldiers from the 173rd Airborne Brigade operating the drones, with no procurement decision or fielding timeline announced.

also.title: US Army launches 18-drone swarm attack from UGV in Germany exercise under new warfighting strategy

stories.title: Eric Trump’s Robotics Firm in Controversial Negotiations to Sell Combat Robots to Israel
stories.summary: Eric Trump's Future Industries Foundation is negotiating a $150 million deal to sell 1,000 autonomous combat robots to Israel for use in Gaza tunnels. The company, which received over $70 million in Pentagon contracts, faces human rights concerns over its Phantom robots.

stories.title: RAF Lakenheath Drone Incident: US Air Force Responds as Personnel Shelter in Place
stories.summary: USAF Security Forces responded to suspected unauthorized drone activity over RAF Lakenheath on the evening of 13 November 2026, directing personnel to shelter in place. The UK Ministry of Defence confirmed the situation is now resolved, while a US Air Force spokesperson stated no personnel, aircraft or infrastructure were affected.

also.title: Are these the drones that sparked US panic at RAF Lakenheath? Flashing lights seen near base days after America evacuated planes amid Iran threat
Drone activity over US base in Britain prompts security response
Suspected unauthorised drone activity over RAF Lakenheath in Suffolk prompts response

stories.title: Launch of Budapest-Belgrade high-speed rail line postponed due to 'software issues'
stories.summary: Hungarian Minister for Transport and Investment Dávid Vitézy announced the postponement of the Budapest-Belgrade high-speed rail line launch, originally scheduled for December 13, due to software issues in safety systems. Chinese companies are required to ensure compatibility with the European Train Control System (ETCS) before an independent quality control body confirms all errors are corrected.

stories.title: US Army tests AI-enabled 3D-printed C-UAS with Republic of Korea
stories.summary: The US Army’s 532nd Military Intelligence Battalion tested Project MANOWAR, a 3D-printed counter-uncrewed aircraft system, at Camp Humphreys and Baegiri Airfield in the Republic of Korea. The unit achieved more than 90% confidence against low-altitude threats by September and is now transitioning the experiment to scaled production and a formal Army programme of record.

stories.title: European Union “to provide C-UAS support to Nigeria”
stories.summary: The European Union will provide counter-uncrewed aerial systems capabilities to Nigeria as part of a EUR 20 million defence support package. The package also includes night vision equipment and counter-improvised explosive device systems intended to strengthen the Armed Forces of Nigeria in ongoing counterterrorism operations in the Lake Chad Basin.

stories.title: What could Tesla’s Optimus humanoid robot actually do in 2027?
stories.summary: Tesla expects its first customers to use Optimus for repetitive or hazardous industrial jobs, with CEO Elon Musk saying deliveries to outside companies could begin around the end of 2027. The company has already begun early production in Fremont, California, and Musk stated that some units are already doing simple tasks in Tesla’s factories.

also.title: Tesla Optimus Aims for 1M Robots a Year at $20K Each

stories.title: MIT Introduces FLEX for Robot Nonliteral Commands
stories.summary: MIT and NYU researchers introduced FLEX on November 9, 2026, a pipeline that enables robots to interpret nonliteral commands and generalize behavioral constraints during physical motion planning. The system uses a three-step loop to adapt manipulation representations without exhaustive manual demonstrations, executing the cycle in approximately five seconds.

stories.title: Tesla Cybercab ownership will come with plenty of strings attached
US Army issues solicitation for C-UAS interceptor
stories.summary: The United States Army issued a solicitation for a man-packable, kinetic counter-uncrewed aerial system interceptor designed for close-range defence against first-person-view and multirotor-class targets. Offers are due by 23 November.

stories.title: LAX’s $3.3 billion automated train pushed to 2027 as Fitch warns of looming bond default
stories.summary: Fitch Ratings downgraded $1.2 billion in SkyLink project debt from BB to B-, warning of a technical default if contractor LINXS misses a Dec. 8 deadline to have trains ready for passenger service. The Los Angeles International Airport automated train, originally slated for 2023, is now not expected to open until at least February 2027, with costs ballooning to an estimated $3.3 billion.

stories.title: China’s Air Force builds drone that shoots painkiller darts at wounded soldiers — experimental PLA UAV injects emergency meds from a distance to keep medics out of danger and buys time during the 'Golden Hour'
stories.summary: The Air Force Medical University built the first casualty-search drone for the People’s Liberation Army that fires darts loaded with painkillers to treat wounded personnel from a distance. Representative Wang Jianqi stated the experimental UAV remains in the development stage because it cannot assess vital signs or load incapacitated soldiers without external assistance.

stories.title: Eric Trump-backed robot soldier startup can't pay staff after founder borrowed $4.6 million from company to buy home
stories.summary: Foundation Future Industries, a military robot startup advised by Eric Trump, failed to pay employees after missing payroll on Oct. 30. CEO Sankaet Pathak borrowed $4.6 million from the company last year to buy a Sausalito, California, home, a move that angered staff as the firm seeks to raise hundreds of millions of dollars at a $3 billion valuation.

stories.title: Kolkata's metro of orange line become driverless and extends to Sector V
stories.summary: Kolkata Metro General Manager Prem Sagar Gupta stated that the Orange Line will use Automatic Train Operations once it extends to Sector V, adding 4.5 km to the route. Trial runs are ongoing on the Beleghata-Sector V stretch, with passenger operations awaiting final safety clearances from the Commissioner of Railway Safety.

stories.title: EV driver finds 'driverless' Tesla Cybercab blocking charger — then a man returns for it
stories.summary: A Tesla Cybercab occupied a charging stall without being plugged in, prompting an electric vehicle driver to report the obstruction on Reddit. The original poster later confirmed the vehicle had a driver and stated that the owner returned to retrieve the car, resolving the blockage without a tow.

stories.title: Echodyne radar strengthens BAE Systems’ drone detection capabilities
stories.summary: BAE Systems selected Echodyne’s EchoShield radar for integration into its Anti Threat System (BATS) to provide persistent airspace data for detecting and tracking drone threats. The selection follows live trials of BATS in Scotland and adds to Echodyne’s portfolio, which includes radars in hundreds of counter-UAS systems worldwide.

stories.title: HMS Prince of Wales prepares for Talon Blue drone trials in 2027
stories.summary: First Sea Lord General Sir Gwyn Jenkins announced plans to launch Northrop Grumman’s YFQ-48A Talon Blue autonomous combat jet from HMS Prince of Wales in 2027. The 2027 sea trials will test shipboard storage, maintenance, handling and recovery for the jet-powered drone.

stories.title: Vietnam: ‘It's a promising market, but domestic companies will take the lead’
stories.summary: Alstom and Vinhomes agreed to supply up to 83 five-car Metropolis trains from France for Hanoi urban rail projects, including a technology license for local assembly of 117 additional trains.
